name: Codeception
readme_excerpt: Codeception Modern PHP Testing for everyone Codeception is a modern full-stack testing framework for PHP. Inspired by BDD, it provides an absolutely new way of writing acceptance, functional and even unit tests. Contributions At Codeception we are glad to receive contributions from the community. If you want to send additions or fixes to the code or the documentation please check the Contributing guide. At a Glance Describe what you test and how you test it. Use PHP to write descriptions faster…
